description: Should you build on this Docker Hub image? Checks official status, deprecation, when the tag was last rebuilt (stale images miss security patches), mutable tags like latest, pulls, architectures and size, and whether the runtime or OS version in the tag is end-of-life (endoflife.date). Verdict and reasons. Not a CVE scan. Price: $0.005 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). In the free trial.

image.description: Docker Hub image, e.g. node:20-alpine, nginx, bitnami/redis:7.2.

name: docker-image

eol.description: End-of-life status of the runtime/OS versions in the tag.

partial.description: True when Docker Hub's API was busy and the registry answered instead (no pull counts or description).

title: Docker image ($0.005)
